_why: Silkscreen legend for the two identical screw terminals (schematic-review ERROR: nothing on the assembled board says which screw is +5V and which is GND, and this board has no reverse-polarity protection). Each pin label is centred on ITS OWN pad's y so the association is unambiguous, and sits just inboard of the connector body silk. Revision 2: relocated after J1/J2 moved to the earned width - the old J1 labels landed ON J1's pads (3 x silk_over_copper) and the old J2 labels fell off the board entirely. remove_text + add_text is the only scripted way to relocate a gr_text; the removes are no-ops if already gone.
_clearances: J1 body silk ends x=16.145, labels start x=17.2 (1.06 mm). J2 body silk starts x=44.105, labels end x=43.4 (0.71 mm). J1 'GND' clears C2's silk by 1.57 mm in y and C1's courtyard by 3.66 mm in x; J2 labels clear U1's courtyard by 3.21 mm. All inside the fitted outline [5.125, 19.7, 55.125, 46.12].
